claims.statement: The single ecshopx-app container co-locates three processes: OpenResty nginx on container port 80, Java (ecshopx-bootstrap jar) on 127.0.0.1:18080, and the Nuxt SSR server (node .output/server/index.mjs) on 0.0.0.0:3000; the separate gateway and ecshopx-web-frontend services from the older layout were removed.

docker/app-entrypoint.sh renders the nginx config at boot by running envsubst over docker/app-nginx.conf with the ADMIN_HOST, H5_HOST and PC_HOST placeholders, writing the result to /usr/local/openresty/nginx/conf/nginx.conf; the runtime base image installs gettext-base for exactly this.

The three nginx vhosts route by Host header: ADMIN_HOST proxies /api/, /storage/ and /wechatAuth/ to http://127.0.0.1:18080 and serves /data/httpd/ECShopX-Java_Admin/dist/ with an SPA index.html fallback; H5_HOST serves /data/httpd/ECShopX-Java_Mobile/dist/h5 statically; PC_HOST proxies everything to http://127.0.0.1:3000 with HTTP/1.1 upgrade headers and long read timeouts; all vhosts deny .ini/.sql/.conf/.bak files and .svn/.git paths.

Both compose stacks mount the parent of the ECShopX-Java checkout at /data/httpd so the container sees the four sibling projects (ECShopX-Java, ECShopX-Java_Admin, ECShopX-Java_Mobile, ECShopX-Java_Web) — dev uses ..:/data/httpd and lite uses ../../:/data/httpd.

The app entrypoint waits for Java on 127.0.0.1:18080 (up to 90 polls) before starting OpenResty, deliberately not waiting for Nuxt SSR HTTP (which historically delayed the listener); afterwards a supervision loop restarts Nuxt whenever it exits, and the container only terminates when Java or OpenResty dies.

The entrypoint forces Nuxt onto IPv4 (HOST/NITRO_HOST=0.0.0.0, PORT/NITRO_PORT=3000, because Nitro defaults to [::]:3000 while nginx proxies 127.0.0.1:3000) and overrides NUXT_API_BASE_INTERNAL to http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/v1/h5app so SSR fetches hit the local Java instead of a build-time hostname.

docker/app-entrypoint.sh launches Java as unquoted java $JAVA_OPTS -jar $JAR $APP_ARGS, so JAVA_OPTS passes JVM flags and APP_ARGS passes Spring Boot CLI-style --key=value overrides with case preserved — including the case-sensitive xxl.job.accessToken, which must match the XXL admin's PARAMS token; both compose stacks thread JWT_SECRET both as a plain env var and as --JWT_SECRET=${JWT_SECRET} inside APP_ARGS.

Both compose stacks define four services — mysql:8.0, redis:7-alpine (password redispassword, AOF), xuxueli/xxl-job-admin:2.5.0, and ecshopx-app — on a private bridge network, with ecshopx-app gated on mysql, redis and xxl-job-admin all being service_healthy; MySQL mounts docker/tables_xxl_job.sql as 00-… and docker/ecshopx.sql as 10-… in docker-entrypoint-initdb.d so the XXL schema exists before the business dump.

Published ports in both stacks: HTTP_HOST_PORT (default 80) to nginx :80, XXL_HOST_PORT (default 8080) to the XXL admin, fixed 18080 for direct Java API access, fixed 19999 for the XXL executor, plus MYSQL_HOST_PORT (3306) and REDIS_HOST_PORT (6379); the app container also carries APP_ARGS overrides including --xxl.job.admin.addresses=http://xxl-job-admin:8080/xxl-job-admin against the application.properties default of http://127.0.0.1:9080/xxl-job-admin.

The dev stack builds ecshopx-app:latest from docker/Dockerfile.app (Maven builder stage + runtime base, pull:false), while the lite stack runs the prebuilt APP_IMAGE and gets the application entirely from bind mounts — ./app/app.jar:/app/app.jar:ro plus ../../:/data/httpd — and overrides the entrypoint to /bin/sh /data/httpd/ECShopX-Java/docker/app-entrypoint.sh with NGINX_TEMPLATE pointing into the same host mount, so even the entrypoint and nginx template come from the tarball rather than the image.

install.sh bootstraps the host (OS detection for macOS/Linux/WSL, Git, Docker, Compose installation) then branches: --full/--dev clones REPO_URL (default https://gitee.com/ShopeX/ECShopX-Java.git, depth 1) and execs dev-setup.sh, while --lite/--fast downloads LITE_PACKAGE_URL, extracts it, locates ECShopX-Java/docker-lite/deploy.sh, confirms overwriting the four project directories, and runs deploy.sh; unrecognized arguments are forwarded verbatim to the chosen script, and the non-interactive default mode is full.

dev-setup.sh orchestrates the full path: check Docker/Compose, resolve b2c/bbc mode and persist PRODUCT_MODEL to .env, configure public URLs/hosts, collect secrets, import the CDN image bundle (verifying both RUNTIME_BASE_IMAGE and MAVEN_BUILD_IMAGE landed), clone the three sibling frontend repos from gitee (admin and mobile required, PC optional), build each frontend inside the Node 20 runtime image via docker run with /data/httpd mounted, then docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build, apply the admin password and companys.menu_type, and poll http://127.0.0.1:18080/ until Java answers because Flyway migrates during Spring Boot startup.

dev-setup.sh builds the Nuxt PC frontend before compose up because the ecshopx-app entrypoint refuses to start without /data/httpd/ECShopX-Java_Web/.output/server/index.mjs, and the build uses two named volumes (ecshopx-web-node-modules, ecshopx-web-pnpm-store) with NUXT_API_BASE and NUXT_API_BASE_INTERNAL pinned to http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/v1/h5app.

docker-lite/pack.sh is the release pipeline: it builds the bootstrap jar (host ./mvnw -pl ecshopx-bootstrap -am package -DskipTests when available, else the Dockerfile.app builder stage with docker build --target builder and docker cp), stages it as both docker-lite/app/ecshopx-bootstrap.jar and app.jar, writes pinned build-time .env values, builds admin dist-b2c/dist-bbc, mobile dist-b2c/dist-bbc, and the PC .output under Node 20.19 with pnpm 10.13.0, then writes ecshopx-java-<version>.tar.gz over the four project roots — excluding /node_modules/ (rooted, so ECShopX-Java_Web/.output/server/node_modules is kept), .git, target/, .env and prior tarballs, and failing if the jar, docker-lite/docker-compose.yml or .output/server/node_modules are missing.

docker-lite/deploy.sh intentionally runs no Maven, npm, pnpm or frontend builds: it requires --mode b2c|bbc, validates the prebuilt artifacts (dist-b2c/dist-bbc index.html, dist/h5, .output/server/index.mjs, .output/server/node_modules and the packaged jar), persists PRODUCT_MODEL to docker-lite/.env, activates dist-b2c or dist-bbc as dist, copies the packaged jar to app.jar, imports the CDN image bundle, fixes bind-mount traversal permissions, and brings up docker-lite/docker-compose.yml with docker-lite/images.env plus .env as env-files — then applies the admin password and companys.menu_type against the ecshopx-mysql container and polls http://127.0.0.1:18080/ for Java readiness.

The root ./pack.sh and ./deploy.sh are thin wrappers that exec docker-lite/pack.sh and docker-lite/deploy.sh with the caller's arguments; release_init_paths in docker-lite/lib/common.sh resolves the lite directory, the ECShopX-Java root, its parent, and the three sibling frontend directories (ECShopX-Java_Admin, ECShopX-Java_Mobile, ECShopX-Java_Web) from the calling script's location.

docker/install-secrets.sh is a shared library sourced by dev-setup.sh and docker-lite/deploy.sh (not executable alone) providing: install_ensure_jwt_secret (resolution order JWT_SECRET env → compose .env → application.properties, generating openssl rand -base64 32 and persisting only to the compose .env, never to the tracked properties file), install_prompt_admin_password (min 6 chars, tty or env), install_hash_bcrypt (Node run inside the running app container or a local runtime image using docker/tools/bcrypt-hash.js, producing a Spring-Security-compatible $2*$ hash), install_apply_admin_password (UPDATE operators SET password for login_name='admin' AND operator_type='admin'), and install_persist_product_model/install_apply_company_menu_type (b2c→standard/menu_type 4, bbc→platform/menu_type 3).

All runtime Docker images are distributed as one gzip'd docker-save bundle downloaded from DOCKER_IMAGES_BUNDLE_URL (default https://shopex-onex-yundian-image.yuanyuanke.cn/ecx-java-docker-image-base/ecx-java-docker-images.zip) and imported with gunzip -c … | docker load — never a registry pull; docker-lite/images.env lists the expected tags (ecshopx-java:17-node20-openresty, maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-17, mysql:8.0, redis:7-alpine, xuxueli/xxl-job-admin:2.5.0) and pack.sh --with-images prefetches the bundle into docker-lite/images/.

Both installers gate readiness on http://127.0.0.1:18080/ answering any HTTP status (up to 120 attempts, 2 s apart) because spring.flyway.enabled=true runs Flyway migrations inside Spring Boot startup; docker-entrypoint-initdb.d SQL only executes on a fresh MySQL volume, so re-importing the schema requires docker compose down -v.

The readme's one-click 'docker compose up -d at the repository root' section (service ecshopx-java, docker/Dockerfile, XXL console at :9080) no longer matches the working tree: there is no root docker-compose.yml and no docker/Dockerfile — only docker-compose.dev.yml and docker-lite/docker-compose.yml plus docker/Dockerfile.app and docker/Dockerfile.runtime — and both stacks publish the XXL admin on host port 8080 by default, with 9080 surviving only as the self-hosted xxl.job.admin.addresses default.
